scope: Fix the Huawei 2026-10-20 review rejection of HarmonyOS 1.0.1; no resubmission authorized in this turn.

review.statusRead: 待修改 / 审核未通过
confirmedCrashes: HomeScreen.dragAngle: Cannot read property localY of undefined
MoodOrbitCarousel.pointerLocalPoint: Cannot read property localX of undefined

changes: Replace unsupported module.deviceTypes default with phone; audit the actual packaged HAP deviceTypes before accepting a release archive.

Both rotating selectors use the shared gestureLocalPoint helper: prefer API20+ fingerInfos, scan legacy fingerList for non-null finite coordinates, ignore empty/sparse events. Word dial also ignores center dead-zone events and settles cancellation.
Explicitly select CoreSpeechKit StartParams.extraParams.recognitionMode=0, so the offline engine captures microphone audio instead of waiting for unprovided external PCM (default mode=1).
Bound speech initialization/recognition with a 35-second watchdog; release engines and timers on completion, errors, cancellation and disposal; discard late initialization/callbacks.

Stream recognized text into the input without auto-sending; a second mic tap requests a final result rather than cancelling speech. Show permission, unavailable-service and empty-input feedback. Disable typing only while recognition is active.

Keep input and mic/send buttons centered and give word-ring labels equal 84x40vp interaction frames. Preserve the intentional circular label layout; Huawei's optional alignment suggestion is not independently certified as resolved.
Increment the local release candidate to 1.0.2 (1000002), retaining com.milo.echoes and the existing release signing identity. AI remains disabled.

regressions: Undefined/null/empty/sparse pointer arrays, pointer id 7 and non-finite coordinates

Actual HarmonySpeechPlatform adapter exercised with substituted device SDK: offline mode, real-recording parameter, final result cleanup, explicit finish, cancellation and late callbacks, late engine release, missing callback watchdog and engine creation failure
Permission cancellation, retry after engine error, disposal suppression, streamed partial/final results and feedback in Hypium
Release archive audit rejects missing/default/out-of-range device declarations
